About this data & voice

Connecting to the published company export…

Values come from the company export and are not independently verified. Currency is assumed to be USD; the export does not include valuation dates. Missing fields stay missing. Conflicting values are flagged for review.

The configured export loads automatically when available. Company records are not included in this repository. Import CSV optionally uses another file for this browser session; optional imports are not uploaded and are cleared on reload. Voice recognition may send audio to your browser’s speech provider. Voice requires a supported browser (try Chrome) and microphone access; typed search remains available.
